graph.title: Arduino Bar Graph
notes: Parts are unchanged from step 1; all are catalogue types.

Each LED channel: Uno pin (11 down to 2) -> jumper wire -> 220 ohm resistor spanning the centre gap -> LED anode; LED cathode goes to the top negative rail (tn), which is tied to Uno GND by a black wire. The resistor sits on the anode side as in the image.
Bank naming follows the catalogue (t = rows a-e, b = rows f-j). The image labels its rows the other way round, so only the hole names differ, not the circuit.

Resistors are in columns 4, 6, ... 22 (resistor n in column 2+2n), and LED n takes pin 12-n. Cathode rail holes tn.5, tn.7, ... tn.23 are an approximation of where the legs sit, because the whole rail is one strip.

The potentiometer is placed in a single row of the lower half (columns 27-29, GND, SIG, VCC), as its card requires. The image shows it straddling the gap. Wiring: black from the rail to GND, yellow from A0 to the wiper, red from 5V to VCC.
The black GND wire from the Uno goes to the digital-header GND (GND.1).
